evidence_classification.analyst_interpretation: The telemetry is consistent with an SSH brute-force authentication pattern. A successful authentication after the failures increases investigative priority, but does not independently prove account compromise.

alerts.rationale: 6 failed authentication attempts from the same source and user were followed by a successful authentication.
